objective: Test whether graph-relative point queries can decode local measured cave morphology across held-out entire cave systems more efficiently than dense GR8 SDF diffusion.

representations.query_target: measured SDF in model units with explicit observed-support mask
geometry_only_features: signed query offset to nearest protected graph voxel in gravity frame
local graph occupancy at multiple radii
query relative height and patch coordinates
representations.attributed_arm_role: upper bound because attributes are measured from target geometry in CW0

model.family: small residual MLP implicit field decoder

training.sign_balance: inverse-frequency within each sampled training patch, clipped to [0.5, 4.0]
training.evaluation_queries: all 32x32x32 voxels for every held-out patch
training.loss: support-masked Huber SDF plus sign-balanced boundary weighting

development_gate.geometry_only_required: beats fitted swept-radius baseline on at least 3 of 5 whole-cave folds by negative mean log ratio across the four morphology distances, with no topology or safety regression
development_gate.attributed_upper_bound_required: beats geometry-only on at least 3 of 5 folds and improves zero-threshold volume calibration without held-out-volume access
development_gate.runtime_required: median full-field decode no slower than one GR8 denoiser evaluation on CT221
development_gate.visual_required: blind owner prefers or ties CaveWeaver against the procedural baseline on at least 4 of 5 representative folds only after automated gate pass

next_stage_policy.pass: admit CW1 graph-neighborhood attention decoder design
next_stage_policy.geometry_fail_attribute_pass: graph representation lacks sufficient local context; revise graph attributes before CW1
next_stage_policy.both_fail: stop learned graph-field decoder and retain procedural graph/SDF baseline
next_stage_policy.fresh_data: remains forbidden regardless of CW0 outcome until a later preregistered gate
